overview.name: Corgi U.S. Industrials 2x Daily ETF
overview.description: The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund that, under ordinary market conditions, seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correlate to two times (2x) the daily performance of the State Street Industrial Select Sector SPDR Fund. It is non-diversified.
